latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic stage and terminalized the same native Goal. It used **144,703 tokens** and **582 seconds**.

The critique recommends adding `Vary`-bound representation identity to revalidation; HTTP specifies that request fields can select a representation and affect cache validation ([RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html), [RFC 9111](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html)). It also flags the “Origin matched” wording and records that handbook code and tests were unavailable in the assigned inputs.
